model: Gemini 3.8 Flash High (serving identity hidden/unverified per contract)

environment.database: Owned disposable loopback cluster (port 54339); random per-test databases

assertions: Configuration matrix for local and hosted modes enforces strict validation; invalid combinations fail closed
Direct Settings construction cannot bypass hosted security invariants (database_url, cookie_secure, tasks_enabled, assistant_enabled, allowed_origins)
Hosted HTTPS origin allowlist strictly validates HTTPS, domain, optional valid port; rejects wildcards, credentials, paths, query, fragment, localhost, loopback IPs
Database URL and sensitive configuration excluded from Settings repr and error messages
Hosted startup checks schema version via read-only check_schema(); rejects unmigrated (v0) or future (v2) schema without creating application tables
Hosted initialization never calls SqliteStore, apply_migrations, TaskRunner, or provider constructors
Injected interpreter cannot bypass hosted disabled gate; /api/intake/interpret always returns 503 ASSISTANT_DISABLED
Full HTTP lifecycle against PostgreSQL: workspace creation, Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite cookies, request, human approval refusal, reservation, pickup, return, inspection
Session isolation and foreign entity ID protection enforced across independent workspaces
Fresh application instances against existing database correctly restore state and replay byte-identical idempotent responses
Idempotency conflict (same key, different payload) returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT
Concurrent HTTP clients attempting to allocate the same item: exactly one wins (200), other gets 409 STATE_CONFLICT, exactly one loan created in database
Concurrent HTTP clients sending identical idempotency envelope: both receive 200 with byte-identical payload, exactly one request row created in database
limits: Locally verified hosted-mode API foundation against disposable local PostgreSQL cluster
Public deployment, Neon cloud provisioning, Vercel deployment, and GitHub Actions cron scheduler remain future gates
Assistant and autonomous scheduling remain disabled in this increment; zero model inference calls executed
